description: Single storey side and rear extensions; first floor side to rear extension
decision_conditions: <p><span style="line-height: 107%;">The proposed two storey side extension&nbsp;in combination with the existing cat slide roof and prominent position in the street scene would create an incongruous and poorly designed roof form, which would detract from the character and appearance of the existing dwellinghouse and street scene, contrary to the high quality design aspirations of the National Planning Policy Framework (2024), Policy D3 D.1, D.11, D.12 of the London Plan (2021), Core Policy CS1 (B) of the Harrow Core Strategy (2012), policy DM 1 of the Harrow Development Management Policies Local Plan (2013) and the adopted Supplementary Planning Document: Residential Design Guide (2010) and the draft Harrow Local Plan GR1.</span></p>

<p>The proposed&nbsp;two storey rear extension, by reason of its excessive combined width, bulk and massing would result in an incongruous, unduly bulky and dominant addition to the host dwelling and street scene, to the detriment of the character and appearance of the property and area. The proposal would therefore be contrary to the high quality design aspirations of the National Planning Policy Framework (2024), Policy D3 D.1, D.11, D.12 of the London Plan (2021), Core Policy CS1 (B) of the Harrow Core Strategy (2012), policy DM 1 of the Harrow Development Management Policies Local Plan (2013), the adopted Supplementary Planning Document: Residential Design Guide (2010) and the draft Harrow Local Plan GR1.</p>
